term: economy, adequate mover, first motion and common world order in SCG I42[4–7]
definition: Economy favors one adequate supposition without by itself denying plural existents. The mover argument splits simultaneous and alternating moving under a selected first-motion premise. The order arguments link corporeal motion to spiritual ends and nonaccidental mutual world service to an intended ordering source.
note: No need to posit differs from numerical impossibility. Jointly partial, independently sufficient, redundant and alternative movers are not identical. First-motion/regularity, celestial/end coverage, accidental-or-one-source exhaustion and no-other-world scope remain open. No formal FirstMover/IsGod, total finite ancestry or whole-ground sufficiency dictionary is selected.
